title: Filter chips that are not reversible
cues: Active filters with no clear/remove affordance — pressed chips that cannot be dismissed
ban: Every applied filter must be dismissible; expose clear-all and/or per-chip remove.
remediation: Apply filter-clearable; stamp data-shine-filter-dismiss on active chips and data-shine-filter-clear-all on the stack; re-measure filter-reversible.
examples: SLED Capture queue: Status=Open chip aria-pressed without × or Clear filters
Nucleus catalog: three active filter pills with no dismiss control
